title: Know Your Enemy
intent: Accurately model adversarial and parasitic patterns so they can be dissolved by light and golden bridges rather than fought on their preferred terrain.
eta_goal: Reduce the cost of conflict by understanding the actual feeding requirements of the opposing pattern.
core_framing: The enemy is often a pattern rather than a person.
Parasitic patterns require specific conditions (attention, division, unexamined fear) to survive.
Knowing those conditions allows their removal without direct combat.
optimized_query_patterns: What does this opposing pattern actually need in order to continue existing?
Where am I currently supplying those conditions?
verification_notes: Successful removal of a pattern’s feeding ground without escalation.
next_physical_or_action: Map the feeding requirements of one current adversarial pattern and cut one supply line.
